specification.gate: Every measured profile passes independent ordered-future counts, numeric action legality, complete serialized own-hand/history coverage, values and exact legal BR replay within 1e-10; deterministic complete payload equality per checkpoint; final gap improves from first and meets fixture target with padding. All earlier and short allocation target misses remain recorded. No runtime promotion comparison or speedup claim. The final known-AA/KK value error must also meet its fixed0.0001 tolerance with padding.
specification.model_limits: Heads-up fixed-flop finite fractional action tree, complete future deck with forced turn/river checkdown; at most128 compatible pairs. Symmetric existing-pot share utility, matched extra wagers, no rake/multiway/later-street betting/full-deck preflop.
specification.provenance: Independently developed from probability marginalization and existing repository CFR/betting kernels; no thirdparty source or dependencies. Independent oracle enumerates ordered future deals and all best-five hands, rebuilds numeric rules and maximizes only over visible own-hand/history information.

timing_scope: Three separate complete solves plus raw JSON per checkpoint; all construction, ranking, requested training and exact diagnostics included. Inputs/GC before timing; independent oracle/replay after timing. No comparative speedup claim.
allocation_scope: Separate10-iteration complete calls plus raw JSON under tracemalloc; input preparation and GC precede tracing, independent replay follows it. Python traced allocations, not RSS or high-iteration memory.
quality_scope: Per-fixture ordered-future/best-five counts prepared independently once and reused as immutable chance evidence. Every profile is independently replayed through numeric betting rules and both legal visible-information best responses; no production policies cached between calls.
